description: Elections Commission - W. P. A. M. Jayaweera has vacated her office of member Ja-Ela Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Ja-Ela Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) has vacated her office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a declaration made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the status of an elected member, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
